name: Mary Jones | 100mg Soda | Green Apple
description:
Same Jones.
More Mary.
More flavors, higher dosages, only available in dispensaries.

100mg Soda Beverage

Mary Jones’ Green Apple flavor is a crisp, refreshing journey, blending the tartness of fresh green apples with a smooth, delightful finish. It’s an adventurous choice for those seeking a vibrant, flavor-rich experience that’s both unique and familiar.
